common_reference_scoreable.interpretation: Comparable cross-model subset only; excludes tasks without a valid reference score for any model.

metric_definitions.evaluator_hidden_correctness: Fresh evaluator hidden CSim, candidate synthesis, and required hidden CoSim all pass. Only public-completed kernels were evaluated.
metric_definitions.reference_anchored_score: Fresh evaluator run_report.scoring_vs_reference; reported only when valid. Missing reference metrics remain unavailable, not silently imputed as zero.
metric_definitions.submission_proxy: Only the 25 QoR optimization tasks; 100 * submission optimization_metrics.best_q_hw * scoring_v3.efficiency_factor(original credits, original submission-side tool wall time). No hidden/reference evidence.
metric_definitions.zero_filled_lower_bound: Sum of available valid reference scores divided by all 150 tasks. This is a lower bound, not an official full-corpus mean.
